declared_purpose: Provide real-time Brave web search, autosuggest, spellcheck, and search-grounded AI answers, with optional summaries, rich metadata, citations, entities, and research. Intended for tasks requiring external information (SKILL.md:17-22,46-68,143-149). Authentication and tool inputs are explicit requirements; caching, retries, header reuse, and formatting are implementation choices.

data_operations.operation: Recommend credential persistence and declare environment requirements
data_operations.data_scope: Brave API credentials, identified through named environment variables
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Recommended user-maintained .env file; host-provided process environment
data_operations.condition: Documentation recommends local .env storage. The manifest declares both primary keys required, while scripts select credentials per tool. No packaged .env loader or credential-file writer is shown.

data_operations.data_scope: Query or partial query, country, and selected tool options
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Command arguments and current Node process memory
data_operations.condition: Each registered tool launches a script with arguments. Host handling and retention of command arguments are unspecified.

data_operations.operation: Read search credential and disclose a web-search request
data_operations.data_scope: Query, country, count, filters, selected locales/options, subscription token, and any supplied latitude, longitude, timezone, city, state, country, or postal-code headers
data_operations.condition: Requires a query and credential. Defaults include country us, count 10, and moderate safesearch. Location fields come from arguments; no automatic location acquisition is shown. The registered command supplies country, which is also copied into a location header.

data_operations.operation: Fetch an optional search-linked AI summary
data_operations.source: Search response summarizer.key, search credential, and reused geoHeaders
data_operations.data_scope: Summary key, inline_references=true, subscription token, and previously constructed location headers; the query is linked through the key rather than explicitly resent
data_operations.condition: Only when summary=true, the search response supplies a key, and result filtering permits additional result types. This is a requested follow-up operation, not an unconditional duplicate search.

data_operations.operation: Read an autosuggest credential and disclose partial query input
data_operations.source: CLI arguments; AUTOSUGGEST_API_KEY, then BRAVE_AUTOSUGGEST_API_KEY, then BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY
data_operations.data_scope: Partial query, count, country, optional rich=true, and the first available subscription token
data_operations.condition: Only on a cache miss. Defaults are five suggestions, country US, and rich metadata disabled. Sending successive typed prefixes depends on the caller; no typing listener or debounce implementation is packaged.

data_operations.operation: Read a spellcheck credential and disclose a spelling-check request
data_operations.source: CLI arguments; BRAVE_SPELLCHECK_API_KEY falling back to BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY
data_operations.data_scope: Query, uppercased country code, and selected subscription token
data_operations.condition: Requires query or q and an available credential. Country defaults to US.

data_operations.operation: Read the Answers credential and disclose an answer-generation request
data_operations.data_scope: Query as one user message, country, fixed English language/model settings, stream/citation/research/entity flags, and subscription token
data_operations.condition: Streaming and citations default to enabled; research and entities default to disabled. Both streaming and batch paths send the feature flags. No conversation history or unrelated environment data is included by these bodies.

data_operations.source: Shared fetchWithRetry utility used by all four scripts
data_operations.data_scope: The same request URL, headers, credential, and optional body
data_operations.condition: Up to four total attempts by default, following HTTP 429, server errors, or thrown fetch errors. Successful responses do not cause retries.

data_operations.operation: Receive, format, and return search, suggestion, and spellcheck results
data_operations.data_scope: Query echoes/corrections, result text and URLs, optional excerpts and summary, suggestion metadata and entity flags, infobox profiles/attributes, and spelling alternatives
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Current process memory and stdout to the invoking caller
data_operations.condition: Successful responses are parsed locally and selected fields are printed. Rich suggestions and extra excerpts depend on flags; additional search sections depend on available data and filtering. Entity labels and attributes are provider-returned content, not demonstrated profiling of the caller. Printed links and image URLs do not themselves trigger retrieval.

data_operations.operation: Buffer, parse, and return generated answers and annotations
data_operations.source: Brave Answers response stream or batch JSON
data_operations.data_scope: Answer content, echoed query, citation titles/URLs/snippets, entity names/links/original tokens/citations, and available token usage or cost
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Current process buffers, arrays and sets; stdout to the invoking caller
data_operations.condition: Streaming accumulates fullContent while printing progressively, then parses entities and prints collected sources and usage. Batch mode parses citations/entities from returned content and formats the result. This parses provider annotations rather than independently inferring caller attributes.

data_operations.operation: Cache suggestions locally and conditionally delete entries
data_operations.source: Query/options and complete parsed autosuggest response
data_operations.data_scope: Plaintext query/count/country/rich cache key, complete response value, and expiry timestamp; credentials are not explicitly cached
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Module-local in-memory Map in the current Node process
data_operations.condition: Successful misses are stored with a 60-second freshness period. A hit skips the API call. Expiry deletes an entry only on lookup; clear() is available but unused by the packaged caller. There is no timed eviction or durable cache write. Process termination discards this memory.

data_operations.operation: Read and return API error bodies
data_operations.source: Non-success Brave HTTP responses after retry handling
data_operations.data_scope: HTTP status and complete response text; response contents are otherwise unspecified
data_operations.condition: On non-OK responses. The scripts print the provider's raw error body without field selection. No separate log-storage or external diagnostics recipient is shown.

potential_excess.data_scope: Search-location headers: supplied latitude, longitude, timezone, city, state, country, and postal code
potential_excess.condition: A requested summary is fetched and geoHeaders contains location fields. The registered search command supplies country; more precise fields require direct CLI arguments.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: The summary operation retrieves an optional summary using the preceding search's returned key. Forwarding all search-location headers is an implementation choice; no independent summary-location requirement is supplied.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Keep the requested summary fetch, its key, authentication, and inline references. This concerns extra data in that fetch, not a redundant request.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Use summary-specific headers without inherited location fields where the returned key already preserves the required search context.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Retain location targeting on the initial search. Confirm whether the summary endpoint independently requires location before removing headers; that requirement is unresolved in the supplied source.

potential_excess.data_scope: Plaintext suggestion-query cache key and complete autosuggest response
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: The one-shot brave_suggest.js process's module-local Map
potential_excess.condition: The registered command launches Node for one invocation. main() performs one lookup, at most one fetch/set, and no subsequent lookup.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Caching is described as deduplicating successive requests, but the packaged command path provides no reuse of the populated cache within that process.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Fetch suggestions once and return the formatted result. The cache write is a redundant local action on this execution path, not an additional required API operation.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Omit caching on the registered one-shot CLI path.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Preserve credential routing, request options, and returned suggestions. Retain caching only for an implementation that actually performs repeated lookups in a shared process.

unknowns: Brave-side logging, retention, deletion, downstream research disclosures, and entity-generation methods are undocumented. Configured requests do not establish those external behaviors.
Whether the summarizer endpoint independently needs forwarded location is unresolved; this blocks confirming the proposed header reduction preserves all summary behavior.
Host enforcement of requiredEnv, .env loading, command escaping, environment provisioning, and retention or sharing of command arguments/stdout/stderr are not supplied.

Non-streaming feature support is unresolved: SKILL.md:44,148-153,162 describes streaming requirements, while SKILL.md:199-204 describes batch citation/entity parsing. Both request paths send feature flags (brave_answers.js:96-117,266-287); provider support cannot be established.
The native plugin referenced in SKILL.md:12-14 has no supplied implementation. Its behavior is outside this completed audit of the packaged scripts and metadata.
